title: Korn’s Jonathan Davis Marries Longtime Girlfriend Brittany Parisi: See Photos From the Cliffside Wedding (Exclusive)
summary: The rocker and jewelry designer have been dating since 2019.
contentText:
After seven years of dating, Korn frontman Jonathan Davis has married jewelry designer Brittany Parisi, Billboard can exclusively reveal.

The couple tied the knot on July 3 at The Neighborhood Church in Palos Verdes, Calif., backdropped by a gorgeous organ inside the chapel and a beautiful blue sea outside, where they cut into their cake. Some of the brightest moments from the day were captured in photos shared Thursday (July 23), showing Mr. Davis’ kilt and red tie as well as the newly christened Mrs. Davis’ elegant white gown and veil.

“We invited our closest friends and family members, only about 80 people,” the couple tells Billboard . “The cliffside setting overlooking the ocean looked and felt like Italy, where [we got] engaged last year.”

The guest list included all of Jonathan’s Korn bandmates: Brian Welch, James Shaffer, Ray Luzier and Ra Diaz. Both the bride and groom agree that exchanging vows in front of their close circle was the most special part of the day.

“Getting married with all of our closest loved ones in such an intimate, gorgeous setting was truly a blessing, and the most beautiful way to kick off our happily ever after!” the couple adds.

Jonathan Davis co-founded Korn back in 1993, eventually earning acclaim for the band’s influence on the nu metal genre. To date, the group has notched five entries on the Billboard Hot 100 , including the 2003 top 40 hit “Did My Time,” as well as two No. 1 albums on the Billboard 200 : 1998’s Follow the Leader and 1999’s Issues .

Now, Korn is gearing up to tour Europe alongside Architects and Youth Code. The trek kicks off in October — giving the newlyweds plenty of time, in theory, to schedule a honeymoon and keep the celebration of their love rocking.
